content:
This exercise may be a duplicate of these two existing contributions:

- Reverse Polish Notation Calculator: https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/110532f3ac8b15e267c487c2d0dd8aa5341d6e
- Push-down automaton: https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/9960950f866299da74feb3431d5cc691345ba

The first is also a postfix calculator, with different operators. The second includes postfix arithmetic within a broader stack-based language.

I would like to leave the decision to the community. This contribution may be deleted if it is considered too similar. If you recommend deleting it, I will do so.
